data.name: Konda
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Konda means bond, connection, or relation. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kri', meaning to do, and 'da', meaning friend. In Hindu mythology, Konda is also the name of a goddess, Kondamamba, who is the goddess of fertility and the protector of children.
